description: Source code implementing FP32 scalar requantization functions for QNNPACK in PyTorch, including functions for lrintf-based and magic number-based requantization methods.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_requantize_fp32__scalar_lrintf
methods.description: Performs FP32 requantization using lrintf for rounding, with clamping and biasing based on zero point.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_requantize_fp32__scalar_magic
methods.description: Performs FP32 requantization using a magic number trick for rounding, with clamping and biasing based on zero point.
